panels.title: Executed-test pass rate
panels.description: This is NOT the bench generation gate. It measures whether the generated Robot test passed when it ran. Spine is execution_records; timestamp is TEXT with an offset, so it casts to timestamptz cleanly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE test_status = 'passed') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS pass_pct FROM execution_records WHERE timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT test_status, count(*) AS runs FROM execution_records WHERE timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Median execution duration
panels.description: Coverage note: execution_duration_ms is unpopulated on every execution_records row measured (0/123, 2026-08-10). An empty stat here means no duration data was ever recorded, not a zero-second run.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY execution_duration_ms)::numeric / 1000.0, 1) AS median_s FROM execution_records WHERE execution_duration_ms IS NOT NULL AND timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Failure categories
panels.description: Categories are also present on some passed rows, so this filters to failures explicitly rather than assuming a category implies a failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(failure_category, '(none recorded)') AS category, count(*) AS failures, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM execution_records WHERE test_status <> 'passed' AND timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY failures DESC

SELECT failed_keyword, count(*) AS failures, count(DISTINCT domain) AS domains FROM execution_records WHERE test_status <> 'passed' AND failed_keyword IS NOT NULL AND timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY failures DESC

SELECT domain, count(*) AS runs, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE test_status = 'passed') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS pass_pct FROM execution_records WHERE timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Pass rate by generated code structure

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(code_structure, '(unclassified)') AS structure, count(*) AS runs, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE test_status = 'passed') / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS pass_pct FROM execution_records WHERE timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY runs DESC

panels.title: Recent failures, with the query that produced them

targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp::timestamptz AS at, workflow_id, user_query, failure_category, failed_keyword, error_message FROM execution_records WHERE test_status <> 'passed' AND timestamp::timestamptz BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 100
